headline: Elemental HERO Flame Wingman
title: Elemental HERO Flame Wingman Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Elemental HERO Flame Wingman. What is it? It is a Level six WIND Warrior Fusion Monster with two thousand one hundred attack. It is Jaden's signature card. What does it do? When it destroys a monster by battle, your opponent takes damage equal to that monster's attack. How do you use it? It must be Fusion Summoned from Elemental HERO Avian and Elemental HERO Burstinatrix. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
